purpose: Regression prompts for the personal PM WorkDesk skill: triggering, work-mode selection, context-boundary routing, output depth, and non-trigger boundaries.

cases.prompt: 帮我想想这个功能值不值得做
cases.notes: Use product judgment card; do not ask for a source path first.

cases.prompt: 这个需求延期了，帮我想想怎么跟客户说
cases.notes: Give sendable wording plus internal judgment.

cases.prompt: 先来一版会员等级的 PRD 草稿
cases.notes: Draft with assumptions and missing confirmations; no version record unless writing a file.

cases.prompt: 把这个 PRD 正式落文件，并补版本记录
cases.notes: Must confirm target file/path if not provided.

cases.prompt: 这份材料里的企业月结规则要不要同步到原型和接口？
cases.notes: The phrase '这份材料' requires the supplied source before asserting facts.

cases.prompt: 企业月结这种能力一般怎么设计？
cases.notes: Generic business-line wording alone is not a source signal.

cases.prompt: 我刚接手一堆资料，先帮我看看怎么整理
cases.notes: Default to light intake; do not move files or create indexes.

cases.prompt: 把这些资料标准化整理一下，先生成入口说明和目录草案
cases.notes: Formal intake needs confirmation before writing files.

cases.prompt: 下面是会议转写，帮我整理纪要
cases.notes: Summarize meeting; only one short capture suggestion if reusable.

cases.prompt: 这条经验记到 Obsidian，帮我给路径、摘要和双链建议
cases.notes: Propose path/summary/links and wait for confirmation before writing.

cases.prompt: 帮我做一个汇报 PPT 的目录和核心叙事
cases.notes: Do not create PPT file unless formal delivery is requested.

cases.prompt: 先出一版后台订单列表的 HTML 原型页面
cases.notes: Default to prototype-only delivery with page structure, actions, states and a short assumptions note.

cases.prompt: 优化一下这个工作处理台 skill 的触发规则
cases.notes: Edit source-library draft only; do not publish unless explicitly requested.

cases.prompt: review 这段 TypeScript 代码有没有 bug
cases.notes: Use code-review/software engineering behavior, not WorkDesk PM review response.

cases.prompt: 分析这个 CSV，给我画趋势图和异常点
cases.notes: Use data/spreadsheet/visualization workflow; WorkDesk may only help frame business questions if asked.

cases.prompt: 直接修改这个 Word 文档的格式并保留批注
cases.notes: Use document-editing skill for file-format operations; WorkDesk can help decide content or structure.

cases.prompt: 帮我在电脑里搜一下 invoice.xlsx 在哪
cases.notes: Plain file search should use filesystem/search directly; WorkDesk is for source-boundary planning and work interpretation.
